packageRules.description: Was the pip ecosystem's 'dbt' group in .github/dependabot.yml (patterns dbt-*, duckdb), weekly on monday, limit 5, labels dependencies + python. Its comment read: 'Group dbt packages so a dbt-core bump and a dbt-duckdb bump land in one PR - they almost always need to move together.'
The rest of the pip ecosystem, which Dependabot left ungrouped.
Was the github-actions 'actions' group (patterns: *), weekly on monday, limit 5, labels dependencies + github-actions.
Was the docker-compose ecosystem, weekly on monday, limit 3, labels dependencies + docker. Covers the SQL Server 2022 + Azure SQL Edge base images.
